items.title: Commitment - a small-yes vow card with a cross sticker
items.description: A cream screen 'From Nikki to Clarity': 'Commitment - This isn't a big vow - it's a small yes to growing with God' above a blank 'I'm saying yes to:' note card with a cross sticker. A faith-journal vow step.

items.title: CADU splash - 'Messenger to your machine' with playful blobs
items.description: A pastel splash ringed by colourful blob characters: 'MESSENGER TO YOUR MACHINE - CADU - A new way to interact with your Hermes agent.' with a lavender Get Started button. A playful agent-app intro.

items.title: Winner Board - Farzad and Ahmed atop global rankings
items.description: A gold-tinted screen: three medal coins over a 'Winner Board' card (#1 Farzad 3,131, #2 Ahmed 1,849) and 'GLOBAL RANKING - Climb the Global Rankings' with black prev/next arrows around a progress squiggle. A gamified leaderboard.

items.title: Photo ring - a circular week collage on white
items.description: A white screen with a halo of ten small rounded photos (people, places, a llama) arranged in a circle - a week-in-photos collage moment.

items.title: Walkify - 'Walk, Earn, Enjoy' reward onboarding
items.description: A reward screen: 'Congratulations! You did it!' with coin and Spotify icons, Coupon Spotify Music, Total 20% Off, then 'Walk, Earn, Enjoy - With Walkify, your steps earn real money, gift cards, and coupons.' with blue Log in / Sign up. A walk-to-earn onboarding, not 'Work. Earn. Enjoy'.

items.title: Trip planning - stamp map and 'Plan Every Stop, Effortlessly.'
items.description: A travel onboarding: 'What place we can go?' over a blue stamp-collage map (Pizza Tower, Mexico), then 'Planning - Plan Every Stop, Effortlessly. AI finds the right places and builds a plan around your trip.' with dark Next and Sign in. A trip-builder intro.

items.title: 'Select a project' card - start by typing, request approval
items.description: A light card on a canvas: 'Select a project' folder row, 'Start by typing...' field and '+ Request approval' row with a hovering cursor. Same capture as VID-0318.

items.title: 'Select a project' card - duplicate clip
items.description: The same 'Select a project / Start by typing... / Request approval' card captured again with the cursor mid-click. Duplicate of VID-0265.

items.title: Trip Dates - Sep 10-17 range picker with quick chips
items.description: A 'Trip Dates - 7 nights' card: Check-in Sep 10, Check-out Sep 17, a September 2026 month grid with the 10th-17th selected, and quick chips (Weekend, 3 nights, 1 week, 2 weeks, Clear). A date-range picker, not a goals screen.

items.title: May 2026 calendar - dotted days and a dinner composer
items.description: A light May 2026 month view with colour-dotted days, 'SATURDAY, MAY 9 - 1 EVENT' (Coffee with mentor, Personal) and a 'Dinner 9:00' composer row with colour dots, Meeting chip and Add button. A calendar day flow.

items.title: Security quiz - 'Someone asks for your recovery phrase'
items.description: 'Step 4 of 5 - Travel Emergency': 'Someone asks for your recovery phrase - A message just arrived. What do you do?' with options (Vault support 'Would never - not now' marked Correct!, Share phrase, Ignore it, Report as phishing). A wallet-security training step, not a bare input.

items.title: Classified document card - tilted note with a wink
items.description: A tilted white note on a blue card: 'This document is classified and unsealed solely for authorized personnel... You really don't follow instructions, do you?' with a small mascot. A playful classified-document gag card.

items.title: Server-rendered day view - 'Today, Tue 23 Sep' schedule
items.description: A browser-chrome card 'app.com' over a 'Today - Tue 23 Sep' hour grid (Team standup, Design review, Lunch with Jonas) captioned 'Server rendered'. A server-rendered schedule demo, not a grocery prefetch.

items.title: Letting Go - guided session card beside an Explore grid
items.description: Two pale wellness screens: 'Letting Go - A guided practice for releasing tension' with a soft orb and black Start session, and 'Explore' with mood chips (Calm, Focus, Sleep) and gradient tiles (Deep calm, Arctic tide, New year, Deep Focus). A meditation pair.

items.title: Invoices - folder cards in grid and list modes
items.description: An 'Invoices' screen with All/Paid/Unpaid tabs and folder cards holding file glyphs (Figma 4, Motion 12, Framer 5, Expo 3), plus a bottom Grid/List switch. A file-folder invoice manager, not product cards.

items.title: Yellow chat trio - 'What are you thinking this afternoon?'
items.description: Three light screens with yellow accents: a prompt list under 'What are you thinking this afternoon?' (Create a video from my photos, Analyse my photo as a DJ...), a thread with a gradient-orb image and long reply, and a mission-brief thread. A companion-chat set.

items.title: 'known' energy reading - 95% Energy with unlock bar
items.description: A dark 'known' screen (ask/you/done tabs): 'Energy 95%' with a reading ('You run high stamina and spontaneous energy... Farmers market Sundays are a steady ritual...') and an 'Unlock your energy...' bar. A personality-energy reading, not settings.

items.title: Quest app trio - streak welcome, ECHAT AI, winding skill path
items.description: Three screens: blue 'Welcome Back - CURRENT STREAK 3 Days' with Level 4 and Today's Quest (Morning Skincare Routine, Push Day Workout, Mewing Practice), a dark 'ECHAT-3' AI chat ('Fabs is thinking...', Pre Search), and a blue 'Skill Path' winding road (Skincare High, Under-Eye Care, Barrier Repair). A gamified self-improvement flow.

items.title: AI listing rewrite - hoodie card with a Siri orb
items.description: A phone: 'Classic Pullover Hoodie updated' card (new description, swapped main image) and 'Done — I rewrote the description in your brand voice, tightened the title, and added four SEO keywords.' with a Siri orb and a colourful icon dock. An AI commerce copywriter, not a signup form.

items.title: IPO application status - 'Congratulations, IPO allotted!'
items.description: An 'Application status' screen with an ornate circular gauge around the NSE logo and 'Congratulations, IPO allotted! ₹1,14,240 has been debited... Shares will be tradable from 24 Sep, 10:00 AM.' An allotment confirmation.

items.title: Poplife - playlist home with a floating home/grid/search pill
items.description: A music app close-up: 'Poplife - Playlist · You' over artwork tiles, a 'BITCH - Lizzo is letting go to free her mind with' track card, and a frosted pill holding home/grid/search buttons. A playlist home moment.

items.title: Single story line - a narrative bubble with voice reply
items.description: A cropped screen with one speech bubble ('Look at you riding like that across the bar. What a fun adventure we're about to go on'), a plus affordance and a round voice-wave button. A quiet story/chat moment.

items.title: Dan's portfolio - folder cards orbiting an intro line
items.description: A light canvas: 'I'm Dan - Product designer creating intuitive products that last' ringed by tilted folder cards (About, Projects, Playground, Contact me). A designer portfolio home, not a Lens Chat app.

items.title: Annotation toolbar - standing highlighter with ink/eraser chips
items.description: A peach-edged canvas with a floating dark toolbar: undo/AI/lasso/3D/crop icons, an upright orange highlighter, and ink (active) / highlight / eraser chips. A drawing-tool moment.
